description: Matteo Giacomo Prina of Accademia Europea publishes the PLANtoACT technology-cost database for clean-energy transition assessments. The XLSX workbook provides annual turnkey capital-expenditure learning curves from 2020 to 2050. Separate technology sheets cover solar-PV configurations, residential and utility batteries, electrolysers, fuel cells, onshore wind and offshore wind. Each sheet places literature or model sources beside an average used as the representative learning curve. Sources named in the description include IEA, IRENA, NREL and JRC. A README sheet describes the technologies. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0. The intended role is techno-economic assessment and scenario modelling for PLANtoACT pilot regions. A limitation is that currency, price-year conventions, technology-specific units and cost geography are not stated in the descriptive metadata. Projections do not establish future realised costs. The related PLANtoACT building-stock record is another planning input; the workbook is kept as one resource.
